question: What is the meaning of disposal options in relation to end-of-life scenario?
description: Disposal options in relation to end-of-life scenario refer to the various methods and processes involved in handling and managing products or objects once they reach the end of their useful life. This includes activities such as sorting, collecting, treating, recycling, and disposing of objects in an environmentally responsible manner.
